channel.title: cooleryu Field Notes
channel.description: Research notes on AI agent reliability and ContextAdapt.

item.title: How Much Code Context Does an AI Agent Need?
item.description: A controlled study of whether smaller, structured code contexts retain action-critical evidence better than naive truncation—and what that still does not prove.

item.title: Codex at 500K: more room, but check the state before writing
item.description: Start with the default, restore missing evidence, and check the current target, file state, and permission before writing.

item.title: Codex 默认 500K 之后：少压缩，不等于少犯错
item.description: 先用默认窗口，找准缺失的材料，并在写入前确认目标、文件状态和权限是否仍然有效。

item.title: 计划没有错，世界已经变了：为什么长时程 Agent 的上下文问题最终会变成执行问题
item.description: 一篇基于近期研究、受控实验与真实执行器集成的迷你综述：长上下文失败不只是遗忘，更可能是 Agent 在执行时仍依赖已经过期的事实与权限。

item.title: The Plan Was Valid. The World Had Changed: Why Context Problems in Long-Horizon Agents Become Execution Problems
item.description: A short review of recent research, controlled experiments, and executor integration: long-context failures are not only about forgetting. Agents may act on facts and permissions that have already expired.
